title: Katana Vault Bridge / vbASSET LZ minter: verified endpoint-only + peer-bound; $0 E-U against $27.76M L1 backing; WBTC 154.17 reconciled
closed_reasons: L2 vbUSDC minter 0x807275727dd3e640c5f2b5de7d1ec72b4dd293c0 is verified source (NonDefaultMintBurnOftAdapter, impl 0x8f45f7acd4b9fc0b446902790f304d444dff949b), not unverified as B0 assumed.
lzReceive is endpoint-only (OnlyEndpoint) and peer-bound (_getPeerOrRevert(srcEid)); peers(30101) = 0xb5bADA33542a05395d504a25885e02503A957Bb3, and the PeerSet history contains no other EID.

L1 adapter 0xb5bADA33542a05395d504a25885e02503A957Bb3 peers(30375) = 0x807275727dd3e640c5f2b5de7d1ec72b4dd293c0; both endpoints are canonical LayerZero EndpointV2 (0x6F475642a6e85809B1c36Fa62763669b1b48DD5B on Katana, 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c on Ethereum).
globalInitializationCounter = 1 on all four minters and all four L1 adapters; reinitialize() reverts AlreadyReinitialized and reinitialize1() reverts ReinitializersLocked (fork-tested).

L2 custom token GenericCustomToken v0.5.1 has Initializable slot 2 (already reinitialized); its mint/burn are gated by mintController/burnController (lxlyBridge, nativeConverter, or MINTER_BURNER_ROLE). The only MINTER_BURNER_ROLE holder is the matching LZ adapter; the admin is the 3/5 Safe 0xd0673F989bc3BA9314d0AAF28BfC84e99B7898CC.

All four minters and all four L1 adapters are owned by the 5/9 Safe 0x619D553686958A873A62B336b2DD97C3b25134EA; all eight proxy admins are owned by the same Safe. Upgrade/setPeer authority is P-class, not E-U.
L2 supply is over-collateralized: vbUSDC +47,689.00, vbUSDT +17,633.15, vbWBTC +0.03280603, WETH +5.04 (LxLy escrow + LZ adapter + NativeConverter backing vs L2 supply).

WBTC reconciliation: vbWBTC totalAssets = 154.17237646 WBTC ($12.560M), backed by 154.1045 shares of the MetaMorpho WBTC vault 0x812B2C6Ab3f4471c0E43D4BB61098a9211017427 (totalAssets 154.18491727 WBTC). The old 33.68 WBTC figure was a single-strategy snapshot; the 154.2 figure is real.
Forged lzReceive, wrong-EID peer, direct mint/burn, reinitialize, reinitialize1, and zero-share redeem all revert on forks (20/20 tests).
open_reasons: P: 5/9 Safe 0x619D553686958A873A62B336b2DD97C3b25134EA controls all LZ minters/adapters and their proxy admins; a compromise can mint arbitrary L2 supply and release the L1 escrow.

P: Katana GER updater 0x3138BBdAeAd339d34F084445192B2be9dd4B9f27 is an EOA and can insert arbitrary L2 global exit roots, enabling unbacked L2 custom-token mints via the LxLy bridge (DEX exit ~$2.18M main pool; cannot release L1 escrow).

P/H-O: 90.85% of L2 vbUSDC (6,052,618.38) is concentrated in the yvvbUSDC Yearn V3 clone 0x80c34BD3A3569E126e7055831036aa7b212cB159 (role_manager 0x2297d2486070655c3a162b02c64248A2f9dBC9a4; 7 strategies).
P: L1 backing sits in MetaMorpho/Morpho markets (owners 5-of-N/4-of-N Safes, curators 3/3 Safes); market/curator risk, not an unprivileged bridge path.

Coverage gap: no full audit of the Yearn V3 strategies or the Agglayer LxLy bridge; the prior r6 lane closed the L1 forged-GER path and this pass confirmed the L1 GER update gate and the Katana GER-updater role.

poc.method: Foundry 1.8.5 forks: Ethereum via FORK_RPC_URL (fallback https://eth.drpc.org) and Katana via KATANA_RPC_URL (fallback https://rpc.katana.network); latest state, no block pin; no transactions sent. Tests cover direct lzReceive, forged peer, wrong EID, direct mint/burn, reinitialize/reinitialize1, zero-share redeem, peer/owner/endpoint/init-counter state, and per-asset solvency invariants.

key_facts: L2 vbUSDC minter 0x807275727dd3e640c5f2b5de7d1ec72b4dd293c0: owner 0x619D553686958A873A62B336b2DD97C3b25134EA (Safe 5/9), endpoint 0x6F475642a6e85809B1c36Fa62763669b1b48DD5B, peers(30101)=0xb5bADA33542a05395d504a25885e02503A957Bb3, init 1, secondaryChainBalance 64,709.272092.

Main Sushi vbUSDC/vbUSDT exit pool 0x5f88eeb3a5662489eb2d5da9f0c73f03355f3009: reserve $2,177,045.85 (24h volume $19,275.76); other vbUSDC pools $275.8k/$840.2k/$239.3k/$26.1k/$8.5k/$7.7k/$16.8k/$11.4k.
caveats: Point-in-time reads at Ethereum block 26,217,817 and Katana block 45,564,084; totalAssets and supplies move with deposits/withdrawals and yield accrual. Re-check before acting.

P is the privileged surface, not attacker-extractable value: the 5/9 Safe and 3/5 token admin can upgrade/mint; the Katana GER updater EOA can insert L2 roots (exit bounded by DEX liquidity, not the L1 escrow).

No full audit of the Yearn V3 yvvbUSDC strategies, MetaMorpho/Morpho markets, or the Agglayer LxLy bridge; prior r6 closed the L1 forged-GER path and this pass confirmed the L1 GER gate and Katana updater role.
The L2 WETH supply includes native WETH deposits (718.244866 ETH held by the WETH contract), not only bridged vbETH.
The 33.68 WBTC figure in r6 was a single-strategy snapshot; 154.17 WBTC is the vault total (MetaMorpho shares 154.1045 of a 154.1849 WBTC vault).
No mainnet transactions were signed or sent; all exploit attempts are fork-only. No secrets or keyed RPC URLs are present in this folder (CI secret scan).
The 5/9 Safe owner set and signer hygiene are out of scope; the verdict assumes the Safe is honest.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0.00 live: the Katana vbASSET LZ minter is verified source, endpoint-only and peer-bound in both directions, has no live re-initializer, and a 5/9 Safe upgrade authority; the $27.76M L1 backing is real (WBTC 154.17, not 33.68), with residual risk only in the Safe/token admin, the Katana GER-updater EOA, and the 90.85% L2 vbUSDC concentration in yvvbUSDC.
